answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the harbor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the haven of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
